purpose: Plane 6 EVOLVE-candidate gate state machine (SIGNAL_ONLY -> EVOLVE_CANDIDATE terminal; no EXECUTING/APPLIED edges) plus the six gate criteria G1-G6 (+G5g).

measured_loss non-null and measurement_method deterministically replayable.
four subfields all non-empty; falsification_test falsifiable; touched_surface minimal.
if minimal_repair_hypothesis weakens governance/charter/ceiling/auto-EVOLVE ban -> G5 FAIL (specialized).
